description: This file defines the NegUnary class within the Twig templating engine, specifically implementing a unary negation expression node. It extends from AbstractUnary and provides the operator method to output the negation symbol during compilation.

classes.name: NegUnary
classes.description: A Twig node representing unary negation operation

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the raw negation operator ('-') to be used during compilation
